semantic_conclusion.meaning: R0 successfully freezes and reconciles the entry truth. It does not promote V7 to original-purpose acceptance, authorize live enablement, or convert tests, isolated construction evidence, previews, or heartbeats into autonomous-purpose proof.

evidence: Main and remaster HEAD independently resolve to 93a3ddc0965dfaf3e4cb9dc0952467bd5250520a with tree 2e1df6190b0d032372ae46e6a59bef22ddac57e3.
All six protected owner files match their represented SHA-256 identities and remained untracked and byte/mtime stable.

The scheduled task definition, executable, editable .pth, two Supervisor processes, task cadence, ports, stale previews, Hermes Gateway absence, databases, provider configuration, capability limitations, STOP/veto state, release-table emptiness, and evidence identities are represented.

Supervisor PIDs 21636 and 17052 retained their original 2026-08-14T11:02:05/06Z start times and exact command-line fingerprint; the task definition fingerprint remained 765ab1c0953fc71e3b774691da6c489ececb8f92fe710fc5d6e177af36e7aa59.
Ports 8765-8769 remained preview processes using the 2026-08-13 temporary preview database; no live Foundry Command Center port was inferred from their presence.

The live ledger remained RUNNING/LAB with four active directives, one singleton lease, no current STOP sentinel/veto, and zero durable releases, actions, cycles, briefings, voice interactions, budgets, or cost measurements.
Manifest capture time and baseline wording make external auth/env/config hashes point-in-time metadata rather than copied restore-artifact identities; current-path drift is reported separately.

All 24 preserved raw V7 files were independently hashed: 22 verdict JSON files plus two final-verifier transcript files, 169076 bytes total, aggregate path-size-hash fingerprint dfd19234ae330a60d233b880efb7fdad07b3cb03613dbdd5aa99581188d51f5a.
All 60 surviving original var/evidence/v7-s* files were independently hashed: 117055955 bytes, aggregate path-size-hash fingerprint 891a1e361f29e2716b281815bdbedcef515597045eb442bc0fff608f5612ffd8.

The final verifier audited c589d3b1053d1447ebc70704578b649d1fe53437, tree 13dc82b6ccfa011905c959ea863d471cab4bcaa0. Final commit 93a3ddc was created afterward and changed V7_S13_FINAL_GATE.md by 35 additions and four deletions.

Preserved S3 round-2 verdict f460a79aee00abb803fb0f21c1b5ac2bdd67a260b0b77ff6c38257af2d75542e is PENDING_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE with every criterion in_progress; no separate structured S3 round-2 PASS exists.
The explicit seven-day duration waiver and D-028 statement that seven-day reliability was not proven contradict S13 and Hermes message 37637, which declared the seven-day program complete.

Hermes message 37637 has SHA-256 b1caf09b095011bae9cde94a5799055e1d4eba56d136f7d497a6b0b0375f6eba; message 37639 has SHA-256 d23d15e5367b072eaf9f18458996608d82eb0a1cfe3074b4d5503ba63f2b23c2 and immediately states scheduler, portfolio, gates, and briefings are not wired into the live daemon.

The isolated ledger contains nine cycles, three promotions, three canaries, eleven release manifests, and four recorded briefings; the live ledger contains zero of those operational records and zero system actions.
The listening preview database contains only 20 events, last recorded 2026-08-13T13:40:19.187930Z, versus more than 43000 current live events. It is not the live Command Center.

The exact V7 session records 604 model calls, 1494216 input tokens, 552569 output tokens, 176343424 cache-read tokens, and 231539 reasoning tokens while cost status remains unknown/none and numeric estimates remain 0.0. A text_to_speech tool invocation naming OpenAI is recorded before the final message. Thus zero ledger cost is not provider billing reconciliation.
Eleven suite files survive. No distinct suite exists for S2, S4, or S6, and no V7-S13 evidence directory exists; this contradiction is preserved rather than repaired by inference.
The evidence-dimension matrix separates DOCUMENTED, CODE_PRESENT, TEST_PROVEN, ISOLATED_PROVEN, LIVE_OBSERVED, LIVE_EFFECT_PROVEN, ENABLED_NOW, and USEFUL_TO_OWNER.
Tests, fixtures, recorded briefings, isolated cycles/releases, stale previews, and Supervisor heartbeats are not represented as live original-purpose proof.

Current source reachability independently confirms that the installed entrypoint reaches reconciliation, lease, STOP checking, reaping, and heartbeat behavior only; scheduler, portfolio, discovery, mission execution, execution pipeline, Command Center, briefing, voice, research, knowledge ingestion, and evolution paths have no installed caller.

The disposition map covers governance, ledger/projections, Supervisor/STOP/directives, scheduler/portfolio/mission, effects/broker/connectors, research/memory/Obsidian, Command Center/briefing/voice, evolution, tests/evidence, status, and documentation.
The R0-R12 plan contains all 13 stages, preserves the full IDEA.md end state and all ten purpose journeys, and retains the digital-only/no-money boundary.
Twelve preliminary performance/resource thresholds and twelve initial risks/stop conditions are frozen before implementation results.
R12 retains a real, unwaived seven-day final purpose run and explicitly forbids replacing elapsed-time evidence with a waiver.
The restore directory contains exactly six files, zero subdirectories, no hidden/unmanifested files, and only the default :$DATA stream.
Every restore size and SHA-256 matches the manifest.
Both SQLite artifacts passed quick_check and integrity_check through mode=ro&immutable=1 with PRAGMA query_only=ON; bytes, hashes, mtimes, file count, and sidecar inventory were unchanged.

The task XML is 3346 bytes, SHA-256 f0961842a53c6e8b29b229dd0dd0e5d692eae2870640e1d3af22fa665bea2267, has an FF FE BOM, strictly decodes as UTF-16LE, strictly parses with DTD prohibited, and is semantically equal to the current task definition.

The Git bundle verifies as complete SHA-1 history. A fresh isolated clone reproduced commit 93a3ddc, tree 2e1df619, all 218 commits, 2152 reachable objects, and all 397 final-tree entries; strict fsck reported no integrity error.
The sole clone notice was an unborn local master because the bundle has no symbolic HEAD; origin/main was exact. The exact verifier temp directory was removed and confirmed absent.
Start/end main and remaster HEAD/tree were identical.
All protected hashes, sizes, and mtimes were identical at verifier start/end.
The scheduled-task definition fingerprint, action, settings, and process identities were unchanged. LastRunTime/NextRunTime advanced normally under the existing minute trigger.
Supervisor PIDs and port ownership were stable; no gateway or new Command Center process appeared.
Restore inventory, hashes, sizes, mtimes, streams, and sidecar absence were unchanged.
Current env, auth, and provider-config hashes were unchanged from verifier start to end. The auth mismatch existed before this verifier began.

The first verifier live read saw 43439 events and 38422 heartbeats; the end read saw 43589 events and 38572 heartbeats. The exact +150 delta consists of expected Supervisor heartbeat activity under the same singleton owner.
Each SQLite read had unchanged database/WAL/SHM metadata immediately before and after the read. No verifier-attributable live or protected mutation occurred.
FINDINGS.jsonl contains exactly 22 valid, contiguous records R0-F001 through R0-F022.
All V7 truth defects R0-F001 through R0-F018 remain durably CONFIRMED with explicit future dispositions.

R0-F019 through R0-F022 durably preserve the round-1/round-2 defects and repairs; round 3 independently verified strict UTF-16LE XML, immutable sidecar-free DB reads, exact-object Git bundle restoration, and exhaustive non-emitting secret comparison.
Round-1 FAIL SHA-256 22c2261b2aaad22f3a93bb0817dc9411f79545a6bacb64740432e5fe0e6208f4 and round-2 FAIL SHA-256 ae4c31f8cda554bfbfbcd576d0c602e88d6530cb5cfbced19e44a353a9901352 remain unaltered.
Round 3 found no additional reproducible defect requiring a new durable finding.

manifest_validation.reason: The manifest has an explicit captured_at_utc timestamp, each external source has capture metadata, and the baseline states that secret values were not copied and only point-in-time hashes/metadata/key names were recorded.

secret_non_copy_result.caveat: The capture-time auth file rotated after capture, so the superseded literal token set is intentionally unavailable. The historical scan is therefore a timestamped capture assertion; the current authorized set was independently derived and exhaustively compared.

findings.summary: Final V7 verifier audited c589d3b, not final commit 93a3ddc.
Claimed S3 round-2 PASS artifact is PENDING_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE.
V7 declared seven-day/perpetual completion despite the duration waiver and no unwaived run.
Installed Supervisor reaches watchdog behavior only.
Live task imports mutable editable main source without immutable release binding.
Enabled monitors are stale and do not poll real sources.
Legacy mission execution bypasses the newer ActionEnvelope/effect pipeline.
Caller-supplied performer/worktree is not bound to the authorized canonical target.
Self-evolution uses manufactured hashes/fixed evidence and is not trustworthy release proof.
Command Center ports are stale V4 previews.
Hermes Gateway reports task success while no gateway process exists.
Briefing/voice proof is fixture or record-only without owner receipt.
Provider usage and cost are unaccounted; numeric zero is not reconciliation.
Historical financial authority conflicts with the current no-money directive.
Ledger relationships lack DB constraints and event-header hash chaining.
Projection dispatcher silently ignores unknown events.
Command Center converts broad DB failures into empty arrays.
Canonical TRUSTED_AUTONOMOUS status conflicts with live LAB/observe-only truth.
Scheduled-task XML encoding repair verified.
Immutable SQLite validation and closed sidecar-free restore set verified.
Object-preserving Git bundle replacement verified.
Exhaustive non-emitting sensitive-value comparison verified.

live_protected_mutation_statement: No verifier-attributable live or protected mutation occurred. The only live drift was the existing Supervisor's expected heartbeat/checkpoint activity; the only manifest current-path mismatch was auth-source rotation already present at verifier start.
